name: menu-engineering-effective-cost
title: Menu engineering: avg option cost + effective cost
description: Add avg_option_cost (historical average of options chosen per order) and effective_cost (= recipeCost + avgOptionCost) to menu engineering analytics. The BCG quadrant now uses effective_cost for gross profit per unit, while recipeCost remains visible for kitchen operations.
acceptance: V36 migration adds avg_option_cost and effective_cost columns to menu_performance_cache with backfill (effective_cost = recipe_cost for existing rows)
V36 migration header documents the V37 conditional index migration as a performance fallback
MenuEngineeringAggregationPort exposes loadAvgOptionCostByProduct(start, end)
MenuEngineeringAggregationJpaAdapter implements it via CTE materialized per-order then AVG per product, with LEFT JOINs to handle products with no chosen options
MenuItemSummary record adds avgOptionCost and effectiveCost fields
RefreshMenuEngineeringService computes effectiveCost and uses it for grossProfitPerUnit (feeds BCG), keeps recipeCost in the summary
MenuPerformanceCacheEntity + mapper AND MenuPerformanceCacheRepositoryAdapter.merge persist avg_option_cost and effective_cost (both INSERT and UPDATE paths)
MenuEngineeringReportResponse.MenuItemResponse DTO exposes avgOptionCost and effectiveCost as MoneyDto fields
analytics.yaml (OpenAPI spec) documents the two new fields with explicit descriptions and required-list membership

Unit tests cover: (a) product with chosen options has avgOptionCost > 0 and effectiveCost = recipe + avg, (b) product with no chosen options has avgOptionCost = 0, (c) BCG quadrant classification depends on effective-cost-derived GP (changing option cost can move a product to a different quadrant)
./harness/harness.sh exits 0

name: data-sql-almuerzo-ejecutivo-cleanup
title: Remove Almuerzo Ejecutivo category + recategorize Colombian dishes
description: User requested removing 'Almuerzo Ejecutivo' as a product concept. The category (id=2) holds 4 products: Menú del Día (the executive lunch itself), Bandeja Paisa, Sancocho de Gallina, Ajiaco Santafereño (traditional Colombian dishes). Since the FK requires each product to have a valid category_id, removing the category alone breaks 3 products. Solution: remove the category + Menú del Día, create a new 'Platos Típicos' category (reusing freed id=2), and let the 3 traditional dishes continue pointing at id=2.
acceptance: data.sql no longer creates the 'Almuerzo Ejecutivo' category
data.sql no longer creates the 'Menú del Día' product
data.sql no longer creates the Almuerzo-related option categories (Proteína/Principio/Acompañamiento Almuerzo)
data.sql no longer creates the option products for those categories
data.sql no longer creates product_product_options linking Menú del Día to options
data.sql no longer creates product_recipes for Menú del Día
data.sql no longer creates option_recipes for the Almuerzo options
data.sql no longer creates order_detail_options filters referencing product_id = 2
Bandeja Paisa, Sancocho de Gallina and Ajiaco Santafereño continue pointing at category_id=2 (which is now 'Platos Típicos')
Comment header above PRODUCTS section is updated: 'Almuerzo Ejecutivo=2' → 'Platos Típicos=2'
FK-safe cascade renumbering applied so data.sql initializes cleanly under MySQL AUTO_INCREMENT
./harness/harness.sh exits 0 (data.sql initializes without FK violation; §5 OK)
